Every year, the Ganga recedes in Haridwar for around 18 days, exposing a riverbed buried under plastic, discarded clothes, footwear and ritual waste. This year, nearly 150 metric tonnes of waste were removed ahead of the 2027 Ardh Kumbh. But with pollution continuing to flow back into the river, can an annual clean-up really make the Ganga cleaner?
